name: How long does an AEO website audit take?
description: An AEO website audit typically takes 2-8 weeks, depending on your website's size and complexity.

mainEntity.name: How long does an AEO website audit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an AEO website audit depends on the size and complexity of your website, as well as the depth of analysis required. For a typical small to medium-sized business website, an audit might take anywhere from 2 to 4 weeks. Larger, more complex sites with extensive content or intricate data structures could require 4 to 8 weeks. This timeframe includes data collection, analysis, and the preparation of a comprehensive report and actionable recommendations.
